AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

Limitation.description: Limitation on the quantity of data returned and optional Cursor for the starting point of data.

EnterpriseIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Enterprises. If not specified, the operation returns data for all enterprises within scope of the Access Token.

Extent.title: Resource block extent
Extent.description: Extent of data to be returned.

ResourceBlockIds.description: Unique identifiers of the requested resource block.

AssignedResourceIds.description: Unique identifiers of the requested Assigned `Resource`.

ActivityStates.description: Whether to return only active, only deleted or both records. Defaults to `Active` if not specified.

CollidingUtc.title: Time interval
CollidingUtc.description: Interval in which the resource block is active.

CreatedUtc.title: Time interval
CreatedUtc.description: Interval in which the resource block was created.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Interval in which the resource block was updated.
